pages.text: Jim Raynor holds the bridge of the Hyperion high in the stratosphere over the terran base.

A grenade and a call to the Hyperion (a Yamato blast). At 2/3 health he calls marines, a marauder and a ghost; at 1/3 he rages and calls more.$(br2)$(l)When beaten$() Amun's hold breaks and the hero joins you (see Amun's Hold), leaving: Raynor's Helmet, the rest of a terran suit, 16 shards, 8 diamonds.
